verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair question for a government filing service with a public website, so the axis applies. Probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), no markdown versions of the docs pages (HTTP 404), and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The documentation exists only as human-oriented HTML pages, so there is no evidence of agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
